persistent_identifier_status: Repository-local stable dataset identifier; the cited journal article has no DOI identified in the KCI record.
title: Grass-clippings silage storage duration and biochemical methane-potential abstract endpoints
citation: Yeo, J., Kim, T.-H., Kim, C.-G., Lee, S.-Y., & Yoon, Y.-M. (2023). Effects of silage storage period of grass clippings on methane production by anaerobic digestion. Journal of Korea Organic Resource Recycling Association, 31(4), 13–28.
source_locations: English abstract: species BMP values and Poa pratensis storage-day 0/180 endpoints
geography: Republic of Korea; exact experimental site not stated in the accessible English abstract.
license: No dataset license or explicit article reuse license identified from the accessible KCI metadata. Factual abstract values are transcribed with attribution; external redistribution rights require confirmation.
material_scope: Grass clippings; species-specific BMP values for Poa pratensis, Zoysia japonica, and Agrostis stolonifera. Storage-duration endpoints are for ensiled Poa pratensis only.
experimental_conditions: The abstract reports storage durations of 0, 30, 60, 90, 120, and 180 days for Poa pratensis, but gives numerical BMP and composition values only for day 0 and day 180. Methods, replication, storage temperature, ensiling moisture, analytical basis for fiber/protein percentages, and BMP reference conditions were not available in the accessible abstract.
data_scope: Eleven records: three species-comparison BMP values, two Poa pratensis BMP endpoints, four fiber endpoints, two crude-protein endpoints, and one explicit record for intermediate BMP values tested but not reported in the abstract.
limitations: Reference-only; not GreenHub roadside grass and not a runtime default or parameter-registry value.
Only English-abstract values were accessible; the underlying article tables and raw observations were not verified.
No intermediate storage-day values are reconstructed, interpolated, or used to fit a kinetic equation.
Storage mode is described as silage/ensiling; this does not establish an aerobic-storage comparison.
Percentage bases for NDF, ADF, and crude protein are not specified in the accessible abstract and must not be assumed to be dry-matter basis.
BMP volume reference conditions are not specified in the accessible abstract; retain source unit wording and do not normalize to a different standard volume basis.
Species comparison values should not be interpreted as roadside-grass values without a transferability assessment.
conversion_or_processing: Direct transcription of English-abstract values; no conversion, imputation, interpolation, uncertainty reconstruction, or kinetic fitting.
uncertainty: Not reported in the accessible abstract. Replicates and statistical intervals are unknown.
